verdict.rationale: Portkey's gateway supports policy-based model switching via conditional fallbacks (status-code triggers), load balancing/weighted routing, gradual migration and canary rollout, plus budget/rate-limit enforcement that can trigger automatic switching for cost/availability reasons - all configurable via routing configs applied at request time. This directly matches mid-task, policy-driven model switching for cost, capability, or availability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of dynamic mid-task capability-based switching (vs. failure-triggered fallback), and explicit example of capability-based routing rules (e.g., routing by task type).
